title: 1904. The Number of Full Rounds You Have Played

examples.explanation: You played one full round from 09:45 to 10:00. You did not play the full round from 09:30 to 09:45 because you logged in at 09:31 after it began. You did not play the full round from 10:00 to 10:15 because you logged out at 10:14 before it ended.
You played 10 full rounds from 21:30 to 00:00 and 12 full rounds from 00:00 to 03:00. 10 + 12 = 22.
